svg.aria-label: Majority-quorum register: Write to a majority; read from a majority and write back what you found.. write: ⟨STORE, timestamp, value⟩; ⟨ACK⟩ from a majority: the write returns; read: ⟨READ⟩ to everybody; values with their timestamps, from a majority; write back the highest one, to a majority; return it. Every two majorities share a replica, so a read cannot miss a completed write; the write-back stops a later read from going backwards.
